enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.
Dexterity +6: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +6 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity.
Reflex Save +6: This item gives a +6 Resistance bonus to your Reflex saves.
Haste Guard: When you are hit by enemies, there is a chance you will be Hasted, quickening your attack and movement speed.
Mithral: Mithral armor is one type lighter then normal. Arcane Spell Failure decreased by 10%. Maximum dexterity bonus increased by 2. Armor check penalty reduced by 3.
Mythic Armor Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
